accountVerified.label: Account verified — {network}, on {date}
accountVerified.help: INFLUX confirmed this account belongs to the registered creator.

audienceVerified.label: Audience verified — {network}, on {date}
audienceVerified.help: Figures observed by INFLUX in the {network} native dashboard, period {start} to {end}. INFLUX makes no claim about follower authenticity.

badge.toRefresh: Audience verified on {date} — verification needs refreshing.
badge.toReconfirm: Account verified on {date} — to be reconfirmed after a handle change.

ownership.instructions: Paste this code into your {network} bio. We check it online ourselves. You can remove it as soon as the check is recorded.
ownership.neverAsk: INFLUX will never ask for your password, access to your account, or a code you received by message.

evidence.instructions: What we need to see: your account name, the period shown, your follower count. Hide or crop anything about other people.
evidence.freshness: Your screenshot must cover a period ending less than 30 days ago.

request.pending: Your request is being reviewed. We answer within 1 business day.
request.duplicate: A request for this network has been open since {date}.
request.expired: Your code has expired. You can generate a new one.

expiry.reminder: Your verified audience expires on {date}. Upload a recent screenshot to keep it.
expiry.toRefresh: Your verified audience needs refreshing. It stays visible with its date until {date}.
expiry.removed: Your verified audience has expired. Your figures are shown as declared again.

dispute.open: You can appeal this decision for 30 days.

advertiser.disclaimer: This badge means a figure was checked by INFLUX against evidence on the date shown. It does not guarantee follower authenticity or campaign results.

line.title: Verification of this account
line.loading: Reading the state of the verification…
line.unavailable: The state of the verification could not be read. Nothing is lost.
line.needIdentifier: First fill in the handle and the link of this account: without them, the agent does not know where to look for the code.

absent.account: Not verified yet. An INFLUX agent confirms that this account is yours by reading a code on your public profile.
absent.audienceNeedsAccount: The audience is verified once the ownership of the account is confirmed on this network.

reason.missing_evidence: No evidence was attached to your request.
reason.evidence_too_old: The period shown on your screenshot ended more than 30 days ago.
reason.evidence_unreadable: The account or the period cannot be read on your screenshot.
reason.evidence_wrong_source: Only the network's official statistics are accepted. A screenshot from a third-party measurement tool cannot be used.
reason.evidence_too_wide: Your screenshot shows information about other people. Crop it following our instructions.
reason.ownership_not_proven: The verification code was not found on your profile.
reason.account_not_public: We could not view your profile without being logged in. Make it public for the time of the check, or give up verifying this network.
reason.ownership_prerequisite: We first check that this account belongs to you, before observing your figures.
reason.evidence_inconsistent: The information provided does not match.
reason.shared_account: This account seems to be run by several people. We cannot establish its ownership for an identified person.
reason.agency_managed: Accounts managed by an agency are not supported for the moment.
reason.terms_breach: Your profile does not comply with the INFLUX terms of use.
reason.minor: INFLUX is for adults only: we cannot process your request.
reason.account_unavailable: Your request cannot be processed while your account is suspended.
reason.other: Your request could not be accepted as it stands. The message from the INFLUX team:

next.redeposit: You will be able to upload new evidence, then ask for the verification again.
next.restartOwnership: You can start the proof of ownership again: you will be given a new code.
next.makePublic: Make your account public for the time of the check, then ask for the verification again.
next.askOwnershipFirst: First have the ownership of this account verified.
next.contact: To discuss it, contact INFLUX from the help on the sign-in screen.
next.none: No new request is possible for the moment.

ownership.title: Verify my {network} account
ownership.unavailable: We cannot show the verification right now. Nothing is lost: try again in a few minutes.

affirm.title: What this badge states
affirm.intro: Once an INFLUX agent has seen the code on your profile, the badge states four things, and not one more.

items.fact: That a precise fact was observed: here, that this account belongs to the registered creator.
items.evidence: That it was observed from evidence, not from a declaration: the agent reads the code on your public profile.
items.agent: That it was observed by a named INFLUX agent. The name stays internal.
items.date: That it was observed on a given date, from a given source: the date is shown next to the badge.

not.title: What it does not state
not.authenticity: INFLUX makes no claim about follower authenticity.
not.stability: That the audience will stay stable.
not.performance: What performance a campaign will get.
not.quality: That the creator is serious, professional, reliable or of quality.
not.commitments: That the creator will keep their commitments.

preview.title: What brands will see
preview.example: Example: the date shown will be the date of the check.
preview.never: Never shown: the handle of your account, a link to your profile, the name of the agent, the internal notes.

affirm.todo: To get it, INFLUX gives you a code to paste into the bio of your {network} account. An agent reads it online, without being logged in. It takes a few minutes.

code.title: Copy your code
code.label: Your code
code.copyFailed: Copying did not work: select the code and copy it by hand.

where.instagram: Where to paste it: in the bio of your Instagram profile.
where.tiktok: Where to paste it: in the bio of your TikTok profile.
where.youtube: Where to paste it: in the description of your YouTube channel (About section).
where.facebook: Where to paste it: in the intro of your Facebook page.
where.linkedin: Where to paste it: in the About section of your LinkedIn page.
where.x: Where to paste it: in the bio of your X profile.
where.snapchat: Where to paste it: in the description of your public Snapchat profile.
where.twitch: Where to paste it: in the About panel of your Twitch channel.
where.pinterest: Where to paste it: in the description of your Pinterest profile.
where.threads: Where to paste it: in the bio of your Threads profile.
where.other: Where to paste it: in a public, editable field of your profile, such as the bio or the description.

code.public: Your account must be viewable without logging in: if the code is not publicly visible, ownership is not established.

notAccepted.title: What we do not accept
notAccepted.intro: Only the code read online by the agent counts. None of these is accepted as proof:
notAccepted.dm: a private message sent from the account
notAccepted.connected: a screenshot of a logged-in space
notAccepted.bio: a screenshot of the bio field

code.renewHelp: A new code replaces the previous one right away.

confirm.title: Request sent
confirm.body: Request sent. An INFLUX agent will verify your account.
confirm.keepCode: Leave the code in your bio until the check is recorded. You can then remove it.
confirm.state: The state of the request is shown in the line of this network on your profile.
confirm.back: See the state on my profile

done.title: Account verified
done.removeCode: The check is recorded: you can remove the code from your bio.

failure.retryLater: A request was refused a short while ago. You will be able to make a new one in {delay}.
failure.cap: Several requests were refused in the last days: a new request is not possible for the moment.
failure.alreadyVerified: The ownership of this account is already verified on this network.
failure.notDraft: This request has already been sent or can no longer be changed. The screen has just been updated.
failure.gone: This request no longer exists. The screen has just been updated.
failure.accountUnavailable: Your request cannot be processed while your account is suspended.
failure.unavailable: The service is not answering. Nothing is lost: try again in a moment.
